 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    # The gray lines split the grid into equal-size rooms.
    sep = next(v for v in range(1, 10) if any(all(x == v for x in row) for row in out))
    hcuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(out) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    vcuts = [c for c in range(w) if all(out[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]

    def spans(n, cuts):
        result, start = [], 0
        for end in cuts + [n]:
            if start < end:
                result.append((start, end))
            start = end + 1
        return result

    bands = spans(h, hcuts)
    rooms = spans(w, vcuts)
    original = [row[:] for row in out]

    for r0, r1 in bands:
        colors = {original[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(w)
                  if original[r][c] not in (0, sep)}
        for color in colors:
            occupied = []
            for i, (c0, c1) in enumerate(rooms):
                points = [(r, c) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)
                          if original[r][c] == color]
                if points:
                    occupied.append((i, points))
            if len(occupied) != 1:
                continue
            i, points = occupied[0]
            # Reflect the lone motif into the neighboring room, preferring right.
            targets = [j for j in (i + 1, i - 1) if 0 <= j < len(rooms)
                       and rooms[j][1] - rooms[j][0] == rooms[i][1] - rooms[i][0]]
            if not targets:
                continue
            j = targets[0]
            d0, d1 = rooms[j]
            s0, s1 = rooms[i]
            for r, c in points:
                out[r][d1 - 1 - (c - s0)] = color
    return out
